B-COLD-FULL-REEXPLORATION.description: Full cold re-exploration: same intent fetch_resource on same /resource/{id} synthetic site but with empty registry and no prior cache; agent re-explores from scratch: discovery fetches 3 observations to build mechanism, then resolve+bind+verify+freshness. Cost measured with identical honest per-trajectory-reset constant sum-counter (3*4=12 discovery + 4 execution =16 per trajectory baseline) plus browser fetches. No prior knowledge reused.
B-COLD-FULL-REEXPLORATION.expected: Succeeds on >=90% fresh tasks at full cost ~16 units per trajectory (Wilson CI width). Repair must be <50% tokens-equiv (<=8) and <40% browser (<=0.4*cold probes).

B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY.description: No freshness guard: same 30 stale instances (10 per family) but resolve() always EXECUTABLE when preconditions+required_slots pass, never UNKNOWN. Mechanism from pre-perturbation executed verbatim on post-perturbation resource, with deterministic _matches verification post-hoc only.
B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY.expected: Near 0% correct post-perturbation (verify fails) but false_accept ~1.0 (30/30 stale accepted, contamination high). FA delta vs SPIDER >=0.90 (SPIDER FA<=0.10).

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.description: Verbatim route/mechanism replay without repair attempt (0-token replay baseline). Stored mechanism executed unchanged, no re-observe patch.
B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.expected: 0% success post-perturbation (verify fails), 0 repair cost. If success >10%, perturbation non-breaking => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that family.

B-RETRIEVAL-RAG.description: Semantic retrieval over prior trajectory memory (embedding search equivalent: Jaccard 0.30 TFIDF over required-filtered field sets + nearest successful trajectory replay). Represents strong retrieval baseline graph must beat; cost includes retrieval lookup (1 unit) + attempted replay.
B-RETRIEVAL-RAG.expected: Retrieves correct family but fails without patch: 20-40% success post-perturbation (partial). Repair should exceed retrieval by >=30pp success and maintain lower contamination.

B-JACCARD-ONLY.description: Ablation: freshness uses only DOM field-set Jaccard <0.85 (required-filtered {id,name,email}), ignoring response-derived Cache-Control/ETag and endpoint _template/X-Csrf-Token mutation.
B-JACCARD-ONLY.expected: FA ~0.66, TP 10/30 only dom_drift 10/10, param_header 0/10 cache 0/10, fails per-family TP>=0.70 for 2 families, demonstrating combined signal required.
B-JACCARD-ONLY.evidence: FA 0.6667 vs SPIDER FA 0.0000, demonstrating DOM-only insufficient

B-HEADER-ONLY.description: Ablation: freshness uses only Cache-Control+ETag plus response-derived header/endpoint _template mutation, ignoring DOM Jaccard drift.
B-HEADER-ONLY.expected: FA ~0.33, TP 20/30 (param_header 10/10 + cache 10/10, dom_drift 0/10), fails dom_drift family.
B-HEADER-ONLY.evidence: FA 0.3333 vs SPIDER FA 0.0000, demonstrating header-only insufficient

B-ORACLE-HAND-PATCH.description: Oracle hand-authored minimal patch (single selector/field-set correction, param rebinding detail->uid, header rotation abc123->xyz789, cache key refresh) applied by experimenter with ground truth, executed and verified deterministically.
B-ORACLE-HAND-PATCH.expected: 100% success with 1 browser probe +1 verify (cost 1+4=5 units). Measured deterministic repair should approach oracle within 2x cost and equal success.

PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS.description: Two positive controls on same stdlib http.server single-resource substrate with honest counter and deterministic _matches: (PC1) Unperturbed execution: mechanism resolved and verified on pre-perturbation endpoint with no patch, succeeds verify()=true; (PC2) Known-break single-attribute perturbation with oracle patch.
PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS.expected: Both PC1 100% and PC2 >=90% per family required; if either fails, instrumentation broken => MEASUREMENT_INVALID

NC-ZERO-AND-RANDOM-PATCH.description: Two null controls with honest counter and deterministic _matches: (NC1) Zero perturbation (identical pre/post resource): repair pipeline must produce zero patch; (NC2) Random-patch null: on 30 stale instances, propose random incorrect patch and measure verification discrimination — must show AUROC ~0.50 (0.40-0.60) for random, false_accept <=5%
NC-ZERO-AND-RANDOM-PATCH.expected: NC1 cost 0 contamination 0, NC2 AUROC 0.40-0.60 FA<=0.05, NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY FA<=0.10
NC-ZERO-AND-RANDOM-PATCH.evidence: NC1 cost 0 contam 0, NC2 AUROC 0.508 FA 0.000, NC-NOISE FA 0.000
